about: Rank table of the Archmage (step 3). model is a full Claude Code model id (pinned, so you know exactly which one works) or an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus: always the latest of each family); effort is Claude Code's reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Override any field in ~/.config/codewizards/ranks.json (Linux; see docs/arquitectura.md for other systems). Estimates are input + output tokens per task, provisional until the evals measure them.
